license: not stated on the dataset card, check before redistributing

eq.filters: lang == English, ratings_consistency >= 0.6, words with >= 5 rows

reverb.label_source: words in the 'agreed' list (other raters), a row counts toward every agreed word

comp.label_source: words in the 'agreed' list (other raters), a row counts toward every agreed word

notes: reverb: dataset lists 6 keys but every row has 5 values, the 6th (wet_dry) is missing, so only the first 5 keys are used
comp: release values were multiplied by 1000.0 (stored in seconds, named release_ms)
eq: units of the band values are not documented, treat them as relative boost/cut
reverb and comp absolute values are extreme, use the 'relative' fields to guide the LLM
parameters are SocialFX's own, they still have to be mapped to Pedalboard (see rag/effect_reference.json)
